B200/us-central1, B300/uk-south1, and RTX6000/us-central1 return HTTP 500/Internal Server Error on the first BioEmu request with the currently deployed digest-pinned wrapper images and no measured samples.
The 2026-05-23T11Z AlphaFold FP32 diagnostic image validates B200/us-central1 and is now mirrored to all Forge regions, but it is not yet promoted into regional_container_images.

The 2026-05-23T18Z B300/uk-south1 probe against the same mirrored AlphaFold FP32 diagnostic digest still fails with bioemu.sample exit code 1 inside JAX concatenate, so the B200 FP32 fix is not sufficient for B300/SM103.
HCLS product safety copy review is still required before default routing or public activation.
benchmark_scores.cache_strategy: Route HF_HOME, HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE, TRANSFORMERS_CACHE, TORCH_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, HOME, BioEmu embedding cache, SO(3) cache, AlphaFold2/ColabFold default ~/.cache/colabfold, and generated outputs under /mnt/data. benchmark_scores.container_source_decision: No official public serving OCI image was identified. Build a Forge-owned FastAPI wrapper on a digest-pinned PyTorch CUDA 12.8 runtime image and install the pinned bioemu[cuda]==1.3.1 PyPI artifact.

diagnostic_patch.b200_evidence_basis: 01Z B200 pod events show the digest-pinned deployed image scheduled, pulled, created, and started successfully before probe cleanup; the persisted response remained HTTP 500/Internal Server Error with no stderr detail. The 11Z diagnostic override image passed on B200 after forcing the BioEmu AlphaFold path to FP32.
diagnostic_patch.summary: BioEmu subprocess failures now raise BioEmuExecutionError and return redacted JSON detail containing exit_code, stdout_tail, and stderr_tail. The follow-on AlphaFold FP32 diagnostic image validated B200/us-central1 with 10 measured warm samples, proving the original B200 failure is specific to the BF16/F16 AlphaFold lowering path in the deployed image.

expected_wrapper_contract.payload_transform: Validate a protein monomer sequence or optional A3M text, write deterministic request directories under /mnt/data/model-outputs/microsoft-bioemu-v1-1, call python -m bioemu.sample with model_name, num_samples, filter_samples, denoiser_type, batch_size_100, base_seed, cache_embeds_dir, and cache_so3_dir, then return artifact metadata and a zip archive.
expected_wrapper_contract.response_shape: Return request id, sequence length, requested samples, generated FASTA/PDB/XTC/NPZ/ZIP artifact metadata, stdout/stderr tails, and model_time_ms/inference_time_ms. Source wrapper diagnostic patch staged 2026-05-23T02Z returns redacted structured bioemu_sample_failed detail for BioEmu subprocess exits instead of a bare FastAPI Internal Server Error.

description: BioEmu v1.1 is a Microsoft Research AI for Science protein monomer conformational ensemble sampler. Upstream documents MIT licensing, Linux Python 3.10+ package support, BioEmu v1.1 as the checkpoint used for the Science paper, and outputs consisting of FASTA, topology PDB, and XTC trajectory files. This Forge entry is deliberately hidden: no official portable serving OCI image was found, so Forge wrapper code now exists under services/models/hcls/microsoft_bioemu_v1_1. The wrapper image has been built, digest-pinned across all active Forge regions, import-smoked in us-central1, hidden-probed on H200/eu-north2 with real sequence.fasta, topology.pdb, samples.xtc, npz, and zip outputs and on L40S/eu-north1 with HTTP 200 BioEmu artifact metadata and 10 measured warm model_time_ms samples. The deployed-image matrix is classified as failing on B200/us-central1, B300/uk-south1, and RTX6000/us-central1 because each returned HTTP 500/Internal Server Error on the first request with no measured benchmark samples. The 2026-05-23T11Z B200 AlphaFold FP32 diagnostic override image passed a full 3-warmup/10-measured probe with p50 7696 ms model_time_ms, proving the B200 blocker is fixable by the FP32 AlphaFold patch; the 12Z cycle mirrored that diagnostic image to every Forge region, but it still needs promotion and a fresh active-image matrix before B200 can be represented as supported in gpu_compatibility. Runtime caches for Hugging Face model files, AlphaFold2/ColabFold weights, embeddings, SO(3) precomputations, and outputs are routed under /mnt/data. The model is for nonclinical protein monomer research and is not intended for clinical decision-making, new protein sequence generation, protein-protein interaction modeling, or small-molecule interaction modeling.
